head_commit.message:
feat: persist codex login logs

Write direct `codex login` tracing events to `codex-login.log`
under the configured log_dir so browser-login failures leave a
durable artifact without requiring TUI or app-server
reproduction.

Keep the initialization local to the CLI login module instead
of trying to reuse the TUI logging stack wholesale. The TUI
path also installs session-oriented feedback and telemetry
layers that a one-shot login command does not need.

Co-authored-by: Codex <noreply@openai.com>
